blocks.text: Another para swimmer shone for Team Philippines on Tuesday, as Ariel Joseph Alegarbes claimed the gold in the men's 100-meter backstroke S14 in the 5th Asian Para Games, at the Rainbow Pool of the Nagoya City General Gymnasium on Tuesday.
